items.title: A Polynesian Mystery Meets Lovecraftian Shores: Call of the Sea (Full Game)
items.description: The Call of the Sea is an adventure game with many puzzles and mysteries. It reminds me a bit of Myst but with a Lovecraftian twist. This video covers the whole game story and score of puzzles. If you're only interested in the thought process behind the puzzles, be sure to check the time stamps as I mark them there. Enjoy! Notes 📝 -My 1-5 order based on tab tallies at the top of the unus (the order) worked in puzzle 1 but there was literally the order written on the back of the puzzle pole that I noticed while editing... I prefer how I solved it because it felt more puzzly than just reading an order. -Lots of Lovecraft peppered in but I am not hugely into Lovecraft (yet). Let me know all the little references and where to start if I do pick up his writing! -Technology is my own personal Cthulu monster. Sorry for the cursor errors. At least I found a fix relatively early.
